BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to license renewals; amending RCW 18.32.180; addinga new section to chapter 18.32 RCW; adding a new section to chapter48.43 RCW; and providing an expiration date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 18.32.180 and 1999 c 364 s 3 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Every person licensed to practice dentistry in this state shallrenew his or her license and comply with administrative procedures,administrative requirements, continuing education requirements, andfees as provided in RCW 43.70.250 and 43.70.280. The commission, inits sole discretion, may permit the applicant to be licensed withoutexamination, and with or without conditions, if it is satisfied thatthe applicant meets all the requirements for licensure in this stateand is competent to engage in the practice of dentistry. (2) The commission shall provide a grace period of thirty days toany person licensed to practice dentistry under this chapter who failsto renew his or her license by his or her renewal date. The commissionshall provide the grace period only if the person has complied with all p. 1 SB 6660of the other requirements for renewal other than submission of therequisite paperwork and fees. During the grace period, the commissionmay not suspend or revoke the person's license.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 18.32 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) By December 31, 2010, the commission shall retroactivelyrelicense any person whose license was suspended or revoked during thetwelve months prior to the effective date of this section if: (a) The suspension or revocation was because of the person'sfailure to renew his or her license; (b) The person would have qualified for the grace periodestablished in RCW 18.32.180(2); and (c) The person renewed his or her license within the grace period. (2) The commission shall alter its records to reflect anyrelicensing under this section. (3) This section expires January 1, 2011.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 48.43 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: For purposes of payment, a carrier shall treat a licensed dentistwho has utilized the grace period established in RCW 18.32.180, or whohas been relicensed under section 2 of this act, as if the dentist hadrenewed his or her license by his or her renewal date.
